Zeta Payments (fictional sample posting) - Software Engineer Intern, Backend

About the role: you'll build payment APIs used by partner banks.

Location: Remote (India)
Stipend: ₹40,000 - ₹50,000 per month
Duration: 6 months, with a pre-placement offer for strong performers.
CTC after conversion: 14-18 LPA
Eligibility: B.Tech/B.E. 2027 batch, CGPA 7.5 or above, no active backlogs.
Must have: Python, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Git. Nice to have: Kubernetes, Kafka.

Apply before 20 October 2026 via zeta.example/careers.
